New messages have no entry yet.", "file": "notifications/sms.py"}, {"id": "R5", "statement": "Current gateway status data: failed = SMS-00002, SMS-00005, SMS-00007, SMS-00008, SMS-00010, SMS-00012, SMS-00013, SMS-00014, SMS-00015 (9 messages); all others (SMS-00001, 03, 04, 06, 09, 11) are delivered. I have enough. Key findings:

- queue_sms signature and behavior; it re-renders from template_id+params, checks sms_ok, feature flag, assigns new ID via next_number over sent_messages.
- Outbox is append-only; a line counts as sent. sms_status.json maps SMS IDs to delivered/failed.
- Failed IDs: SMS-00002, 05, 07, 08, 10, 12, 13, 14, 15 (9 messages).
- SmsMessage fields.
- Script conventions: sys.path insert, docstring must say it sends SMS.
- next_number/format_sms_id.
- store functions.
- Note: queue_sms re-renders text from template/params — same message. But if household sms_ok is False it raises; also phone may have changed — queue_sms uses household.phone from registry, not original phone. Ticket says "same message and details as the original" — original phone is in the outbox record. queue_sms uses current registry phone. Worth noting.
- Also note: queue_sms raises RuntimeError if sms disabled; feature flag currently True.
- Idempotency: script must be run once; re-running would duplicate. No built-in dedup.
